scope: Integrated candidate prepared-data admission through Android ART and the ARM64 packaged server runtime, stopping at schema verification

environment.platform: Offline Debian 12 ARM64 kernel 6.1.0-54-arm64 guest under QEMU TCG
environment.productionSourceOverlay: candidate Android DEX and Python session helper in the disposable store

execution.proot: Signed stock v15 NativeProcessBridge and PRoot, PROOT_NO_SECCOMP=1, --kill-on-exit --sysvipc -0
execution.applicationCode: LocalServerSession.Handle.cacheSelection with retained application import and admission leases, then a fresh package-owned PRoot child calling server_session.prepare and prepared_data_cache.admit
execution.harness: The five generated world-format files and SQL/program inputs are fixtures. The observer counts real full audits and ends the normal data path on entry to schema verification. The warm cancellation case calls admit directly.

measurements.observer: The initial external 420 s watchdog expired on the slow emulated cold and owner-loss trials. The Android owners recorded their durable results. After infrastructure interruption, a fresh offline boot over the retained Android store completed the separate cancellation and corruption trials.

privatePublicationFallback.actor: Separate root-launched ART trial on same emulator with private index parent deliberately left mode 0755

independentIoControl.source: Earlier same-UID authorized 32 MiB synthetic VMAP test, different operation and workload

limits: Device-local proof applies only to the selected volume and owner on that admission. The Redroid kernel does not enforce SELinux. Hard-link denial, ineffective timestamps or lock contention proof, missing/stale index, or changed source selection yields the full audit or identity rejection. Eligibility on a physical Thor is unmeasured.
These runs do not execute the subsequent SQL schema step, native auth/world service, client, gameplay or user saves. Wall times include staging and emulated Python process startup.

independentFinalAdmissionMeter.scope: Packaged ARM64 PRoot test of the v16 meter helper in a separate disposable app-owned directory. One synthetic WDBC payload and small generated files. This trial calls the production audit and seal entry points directly.
